title: Plynth Blender job, version 1
description: Written by Plynth as job.json in a work folder and passed to Blender with: blender --background [--factory-startup] -noaudio --python-exit-code 3 --python <scripts>/plynth_worker.py -- --job <work>/job.json. The worker runs the task and writes the result file named by result_file (schema blender-result). While it runs it prints progress lines of the form PLYNTH:{"progress": {"step": "...", "index": 1, "count": 9, "message": "..."}}. Paths are absolute with forward slashes. Lengths are metres.

task.description: A task of the worker's task registry (blender/plynth/tasks/).

params.description: Read the saved add-on state as data. The probe always runs with factory startup in Plynth's private folder.

user_folders.description: The user's own Blender folders, absolute paths. They are only read and need not exist. There are no defaults.

format.description: An importer of the worker's importer registry (blender/plynth/importers/).

output_folder.description: An empty folder. The worker writes asset.blend, textures/ and thumb.png into it.

bake_size.description: Pixels across a material map rendered with Eevee over the material's UV square (catalog/AssetJobs.h, step material_maps).

fbx_file.description: Where to export the model as asset.fbx for the live preview, or null for no export.

params.description: Everything the build needs. plan is plan.json as saved; floors holds the shapes core worked out from it (core/include/plynth/core/BuildGeometry.h). All positions are Blender world coordinates in metres: X = plan x, Y = -plan y, Z up from the first floor's level. Outer rings run anticlockwise seen from above, holes clockwise, the first point not repeated.

output_folder.description: The project's build folder. The worker writes blend_file and fbx_file into it, each under a temporary name first and renamed at the end.

fbx_file.description: The FBX the 3D preview loads, or null for none.

materials_file.description: Written with the FBX into output_folder (schema/build-materials.schema.json): the images of every channel of each built material, for the 3D preview. null exactly when fbx_file is null.

textures_folder.description: The folder in output_folder for the constant images of the neutral looks.

preview_folder.description: The folder in output_folder for the preview parts: one FBX per floor, one for the slab above it and one for its roofs, and parts.json (schema/build-preview.schema.json). null exactly when fbx_file is null.

preview_textures_folder.description: The folder in output_folder for scaled copies of images larger than preview_texture_size, which building.fbx and materials.json use instead. building.blend keeps the full size images.

preview_texture_size.description: The longest side of an image the 3D preview loads.

fill_openings.description: Put a door or a window into every door and window opening.

assets.description: Each asset the items use, once.

collection.description: The collection in blend_file that holds the asset, named after its id.

materials.description: The image maps of each material inside the asset (asset info.json material_maps), full size, absolute. Empty for an asset cleaned before milestone 10 that was not refreshed yet.
Each library material the built surfaces use, once, sorted by id. Every material field of the floors names one of these or is null (the neutral look).

maps.description: Absolute paths. base_color is sRGB, the rest linear; grey maps are read from the red channel; normal is OpenGL.

slots.description: Every material slot the built surfaces use, once, sorted by name (core/include/plynth/core/MaterialSlots.h). The Blender material of a face is named after its slot. Every slot field of the floors names one of these.

material.description: The library material the slot shows, or null for the neutral look of surface.

generators.description: Each generator file a built generator item uses, once, sorted by id (core/include/plynth/core/GeneratorBuild.h). Empty when there are none.

file.description: Absolute path of the .py file in Library/generators.

addons.description: Short module names of the add-ons it needs.

params.description: Export the last build for Unreal (core/include/plynth/core/ExportJob.h): open blend_file without saving it, make every object ready, run the quality checks, and write the groups and Textures/ into output_folder.

output_folder.description: An empty staging folder, export/.staging. The worker writes the group files and textures_folder into it.

groups.description: The files to write, from the project's exporter. A UCX_ collision mesh goes into the file of the object it belongs to. An object goes to the group whose members name its kind and id, else the group whose members name its kind with a null id, else the first group without members whose kinds and ids take it, else the group with rest (core/include/plynth/core/Exporter.h). When any group has rest, a group with no members, kinds or ids takes nothing unless it is the rest group; when none has rest, such a group takes every object, as in a single export. A UCX_ mesh without its object is placed like an object with no kind and no id. Objects of kind kit never go into a group. A group that gets no object is not written.

kinds.description: plynth_kind values the group takes; empty does not narrow by kind. Not used when members is not empty.

ids.description: plynth_id values the group takes; empty does not narrow by id. Not used when members is not empty.

name.description: The group's name as the user sees it.

members.description: The objects the group takes. Missing or empty: kinds and ids decide. With those empty too, the group takes everything when no group has rest, and otherwise nothing except what rest gives it.

rest.description: Takes every object no other group takes. At most one group has it. Missing means false.

kit.description: The modular kit to make and write (core/include/plynth/core/Kit.h), or null. Missing means null.

fill_openings.description: Put the door or window into the pieces listed in their fills.

bevel.description: The build's bevel. Edges of faces with kit_cut are not bevelled.

materials.description: The materials list of build/materials.json (schema build-materials), so textures are named after their catalog material. Empty when the file is missing. tile_size is the one the build used, from that file. Only for a catalog material without one there does core add the library's, when it can look it up. The kit's UVs are divided by it.

expected_bounds.description: World bounds of every wall solid, worked out by core from the plan, for the scale checks. null when the plan has no walls.

build.description: What the last build report says, for the build_current and build_complete checks.

plan_changed.description: True when the plan or project settings changed since the build, or there is no report.

problems.description: The problems of build/build.json, in its form.

low_texel_density.description: Base color pixels per metre below which a surface gets a warning.

force.description: Write the files even when a scene check fails.

write.description: false runs the scene checks only and writes nothing.

params.description: Make every map of one material into output_folder/textures/ and render output_folder/thumb.png (core/include/plynth/core/catalog/MaterialJobs.h). Blender's own baking is never used: it needs Cycles.

kind.description: A source of the worker's material source registry (blender/plynth/materials/sources/).

path.description: texture_set: a folder, a zip or one image file. blend: a .blend file, opened and never saved.

material.description: blend: the material's name, or null for the only one. Always null for texture_set.

maps.description: Absolute image files the user picked for channels. They win over names and material.json.

values.description: Single values for channels without an image. They win over material.json.

normal.description: auto reads the convention from the normal map's name (gl or opengl, dx or directx) and takes OpenGL otherwise. DirectX maps get their green channel flipped.

output_folder.description: An empty folder. The worker writes textures/<channel>.<ext> and thumb.png into it.

bake_size.description: Pixels across a channel rendered with Eevee.

thumbnail.description: Assets: three quarter view from the front right, 25 degrees up, 50 mm lens, framed with an 8 percent margin. Materials: a sphere 1 m across and a flat tile 1 m square side by side at real world size. Both: neutral studio lights, a plain background of this color, Standard view transform, square 8 bit RGB PNG, rendered with Eevee. There is no other engine.

materialRef.description: The id of an entry of the build's materials list, or null for the neutral look of the surface.

absoluteMaps.description: Absolute paths. base_color is sRGB, the rest linear; grey maps are read from the red channel; normal is OpenGL.

slotName.description: A material slot name, for example Living_Floor or Exterior_Wall: letters, digits and _.

slotRef.description: The name of an entry of the build's slots list. Its material is the same as the material field beside it.

surfaceName.description: The neutral surface whose look a slot gets when it has no material.

collisionShape.description: Convex pieces and hulls for one built object (core/include/plynth/core/Collision.h). Each becomes a closed convex mesh UCX_<object name>_<NN>, numbered from 00 over the pieces and then the hulls.

target.description: The built object: the one whose plynth_kind is kind and plynth_id is id (the floor for walls, thresholds, slab and roof, the room for floor and ceiling, the stair for stair). For a roof also the one whose plynth_roof_index is index.

index.description: The roof's index for a roof, 0 otherwise.

hulls.description: Point sets in world X, Y and Z; the build makes the convex hull of each. Only roofs have any.

outline.description: Convex, anticlockwise seen from above, world X and Y.

tileSize.description: The real world size of one tile in metres: width along U, height along V.

exportMember.description: One built object an export group takes: its plynth_kind and plynth_id. A null id takes every object of the kind that no exact member takes.

kitPiece.description: One unique piece of the modular kit in the one frame stored for it (core/include/plynth/core/Kit.h rules 8 and 9): origin at floor level, X along a wall in either direction (for a curved piece along its chord, world X for a corner with no plan point), Y a quarter turn anticlockwise from X seen from above, Z up. The origin is not always at the first end of the piece along its wall.

wall_solids.description: The piece's solids, raised from z 0, in the form of a build floor's wall_solids.

openings.description: Every opening whose cut reaches into the piece, in the piece's frame, with an empty threshold.

fills.description: Ids of the openings whose door or window this piece gets.

collision.description: Convex prisms in the piece's frame, named UCX_<mesh>_<NN> in this order.

wallRing.description: A ring of a wall solid. edges[i] is the side face standing on the edge from points[i] to points[i + 1], the last back to the first. The solid is to the left of each edge seen from above.

wall.description: The wall the face belongs to. null only on a kit_cut face, which lies between two pieces.

side.description: The face of the wall this edge belongs to, or null for an end face across the wall.

room.description: The room the face looks into, or null when it looks into no room.

material.description: The material of the face: the wall's inside material for its room, or its outside one when room is null.

slot.description: <Room label>_Wall when room is set, Exterior_Wall otherwise (or the same with the material added, see MaterialSlots.h).

kit_cut.description: Kit pieces only: the face lies on a cut between two pieces; side and room are null and its edges are not bevelled. Missing means false.

elevation.description: The floor's level above the first floor's.

wall_solids.description: The floor's walls as solids of one height each that never overlap, tallest first.

top_material.description: The material of the solid's top and bottom faces.

rooms.description: Rooms whose walls close, each with its floor area.

area.description: Square metres, the same area the app shows.

polygons.description: The floor face: the room's floor area minus the holes of stairs arriving from the floor below.

ceiling_polygons.description: The ceiling face: the room's floor area minus the holes of stairs that climb from this floor.

slab.description: The slab above the floor (core/include/plynth/core/Storeys.h). Side faces on every ring of polygons from bottom to top, each edge or well as sides says; bottom faces only for undersides; top faces only for tops. Object SM_<floor>_Slab, plynth_kind slab.

sides.description: One entry per polygon, in the same order. outline[i] is the side face on the edge from point i of the outline to the next, the last back to the first; holes[h][i] the same on hole h. edge: the outside band, also round a courtyard. well: the side of a stair well, also where it is part of the outline.

tops.description: The ledges too narrow for a roof section: faces at top, facing up, with the edge material.

materials.description: Neutral surfaces when null: edge Wall_Outside, well Wall_Inside, underside Soffit.

slots.description: The slot of each part: edge (and the ledge tops) Exterior_Wall, well Stair_Well, underside Soffit, or the same with the material added (MaterialSlots.h).

stairs.description: Stairs that climb from this floor and can be built (core/include/plynth/core/Stairs.h). Object SM_<floor>_<stair>_Stair, plynth_kind stair; each step a closed prism. Neutral surface Stair.

slot.description: Stair, or the same with the material added.

hole.description: The footprint cut through the slab and the rooms above.

roofs.description: The floor's roof sections (core/include/plynth/core/Roofs.h), each finished faces. Object SM_<floor>_Roof_<NN>, NN the index from 00, plynth_kind roof. Neutral surfaces when null: covering Roof for pitched types and Flat_Roof for flat, underside Soffit, edge Fascia, gable and parapet Wall_Outside, glazing Glass.

section.description: The roof section entry that applies, or null for the plan's default.

outline.description: Planar, anticlockwise seen from the side the face looks toward.

slot.description: covering Roof, or Flat_Roof for a flat roof; underside Soffit; edge Fascia; gable and parapet Exterior_Wall; glazing Glass; or the same with the material added.

items.description: Items whose asset is in the job's assets list.

location.description: Where the asset's pivot (bottom centre) goes.

rotation_z.description: Radians about Z: minus the plan rotation.

collision.description: The floor's collision: walls first, then each room's floor and ceiling, then the thresholds, the slab, the stairs and the roofs. Items and generator items get a convex hull made by the build and are not listed.

generator_items.description: Items that run a generator of the job's generators list, in the floor's item order. Empty when there are none.

buildGeneratorItem.description: The worker calls the generator's generate(gen) with these values, joins the meshes it returns into SM_<generator>_<id> and places it like an item: its bottom centre at location, turned by rotation_z.

params.description: Every declared parameter, after core fitted them to the declaration. Numbers in metres or degrees. A material value is the id of an entry of the job's materials list, or null for the neutral look Generated.

location.description: Where the result's bottom centre goes.

rotation_z.description: Radians about Z: minus the plan rotation.

size.description: The size the declaration gives for these values; the worker warns generator_size when the result reaches more than 1 cm past it.

slots.description: One slot per material parameter: the parameter id to the name of an entry of the build's slots list.

buildOpening.description: An opening that fits its wall. The opening's own box: u along the wall from -width/2 (Start jamb) to width/2, v up from 0 at the sill. Point (u, v, w), w across the wall toward its right side, is at centre + tangent * u + right * w in X and Y and at Z = floor level + sill + v.

outline.description: The shape in the opening's own box, (u, v), anticlockwise.

inner_outline.description: outline made smaller by the frame width; for doors and plain openings with sill 0 the bottom stays at v = 0. Empty when nothing is left.

cutter.description: Two rings of the same length beyond each wall face; point i of both is the same outline point.

threshold.description: The cut through the wall band at floor level when the sill is 0, so the floor carries on through. Empty otherwise.

materials.description: reveal: the faces the cut makes. threshold: the threshold face (when there is one). door, frame, glass, handle: the parts of the fill.

slots.description: The slot of each part. reveal is the slot of the wall face whose material it follows; threshold the floor slot of the room it follows, or Threshold; the fill parts Door, Frame, Glass and Handle.
